text_block_list.text:
Red Desire's performance at the Shuka Sho
sent massive shockwaves through the racing world.

Having attained immense brilliance, the saint set her next target on...
the Japan Cup, where the era-defining titans gather.
And reigning supreme over it all was the Umamusume I admired—

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Whenever I walk through the city, voices call out my name,
and magazine pages leap with the words 'Saint of a New Era'...

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: "To think the era seeks the Saint's guidance to such an extent—ehehe... heheheh♪"

After the fierce battles of the Triple Tiara races,
Red Desire is in absolutely peak condition.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: However, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
For this upcoming Japan Cup... the public seems to be watching closely
to see how well I can hold my own
against that person.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"Naturally...
She is the one everyone looks up to."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Everyone is eagerly awaiting your splendid performance at the Japan Cup...!

And that person was none other
than Vodka, whom she idolized so dearly.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Ah... No way, no way!
To think I could share such a grand stage with Vodka-san...!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Just imagining it
makes the sacred mana dwelling within my body
feel like it's about to burst forth...!

—She's in exceptionally high spirits.
A fleeting sense of unease crosses my mind.

Vodka isn't the only powerhouse
gathering for the Japan Cup.

From Senior-class veterans like Vodka
to top contenders who ran the Classic Triple Crown route.

And with the world's strongest competitors gathered in one place,
it was bound to be an unprecedentedly grueling trial.

—If you get swept away in excitement,
victory will surely elude you.
choice_data_list: Desire... I want to make you win again next time too
Desire... I want to help you win again next time too

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Ufufu... I understand completely.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
I am not heading to the Japan Cup
just to idolize Vodka-san.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: That dazzling figure I admire, look up to, and adore—I will completely surpass her with these legs of mine, and aim for a whole new world!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: "That is both a new trial bestowed upon me, and the ultimate bliss."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
It is also the greatest courtesy I can show Vodka-san,
who acknowledged me as an 'equal rival'
and guided me onto a new path.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Therefore, please rest assured.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"Our souls resonate together—
we always advance toward a single destination under the same shared conviction."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Haah—
Hyaaaaaahhh!!

True to her word, her training thereafter became
even more fierce and razor-sharp than ever before.
choice_data_list: (If it's her as she is now, maybe—!)

text_block_list.text:
The day of the Japan Cup.
Throngs of race fans flooded the venue to witness this historic clash.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
(So this is the Japan Cup—
a battlefield where champions from all walks of life gather...)

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: The hopes, the prayers, and the dreams of every racing fan...

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Feelings encompassing all of that
are swirling right here—
(*shiver*...)

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I also...
to this heat—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Yo, Desire!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Vodka-san...!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: What, are you nervous?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: N-No...

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: (Vodka-san... You truly are amazing. To remain completely unfazed, even in the face of all this passion...)

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Just doing what you always do is fine.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Just run with all your might toward the goal you aim for, as you always do.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"I'll do the same. No matter who my opponent is,
I run to become the coolest version of myself I can be."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Beyond staying true to myself and running to the very end—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: A world no one has ever seen is waiting for us!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Don't let them overwhelm you, Desire.
Let's give it everything we've got!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Vodka-san......
I'll engrave your words into my heart.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
On the grand stage of the Japan Cup,
turning even my admiration for you into fuel...!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: I shall ascend to even greater heights!

The endless "desire" of the strong,
poised to burn everything to ashes,
now—blazed a crimson red.
